benefits.zh: switch off 可以描述某人不再聆聽或留心的情況。
benefits.en: Switch off can describe the moment when someone stops listening or paying attention.

benefits.zh: switch on 和 switch off 可用來談論燈、電腦、風扇、暖氣系統和其他設備。
benefits.en: Switch on and switch off are useful when talking about lights, computers, fans, heating and other equipment.

benefits.zh: switch itself on 和 switch itself off 可以表示機器自動啟動或關閉。
benefits.en: Switch itself on and switch itself off can show that a machine starts or stops automatically.

benefits.titleZh: 談論頻道和系統的轉換
benefits.titleEn: Talk about changing channels and systems
benefits.zh: switch over 可以描述轉看另一個電視節目，或改用另一個應用程式、支付系統或工作方式。
benefits.en: Switch over can describe changing to another television programme, app, payment system or way of working.
